steps.label: large, independent work
steps.sub: same op, many elements, no cross-talk

eyebrow: A training loop is already a CPU/GPU split
code:
for batch in dataloader:       # CPU: I/O, augment, collate
    images, labels = batch
    images = images.to("cuda")  # transfer
    outputs = model(images)     # GPU: forward
    loss = loss_fn(outputs, labels)
    loss.backward()             # GPU: gradients
    optimizer.step()            # GPU: update
caption: DataLoader work stays on the CPU; tensor ops after .to("cuda") run on the GPU

eyebrow: Checking where a tensor actually lives
code:
print(torch.cuda.is_available())
x = torch.randn(4, 4)
print(x.device)          # cpu
x = x.to("cuda")
print(x.device)          # cuda:0
caption: Mismatched devices between a model and its input raise a RuntimeError
